details.question: Calculate the average time (in days) between a customer's first completed order and their second completed order.
details.reference_sql: WITH ranked_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date ASC) AS order_num FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'), paired_orders AS (SELECT o1.customer_id, JULIANDAY(o2.order_date) - JULIANDAY(o1.order_date) AS days_between FROM ranked_orders o1 JOIN ranked_orders o2 ON o1.customer_id = o2.customer_id WHERE o1.order_num = 1 AND o2.order_num = 2) SELECT ROUND(AVG(days_between), 1) AS avg_days_to_second_order FROM paired_orders;
details.generated_sql: WITH completed AS (SELECT customer_id, order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'), first_second AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_date END) AS first_date, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_date END) AS second_date FROM completed WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2) SELECT ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(second_date) - JULIANDAY(first_date)), 2) AS avg_days_between_first_and_second FROM first_second LIMIT 100

details.question: Find the product with the highest revenue from completed orders that also maintains an average review rating of at least 4.0.
details.reference_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 4.0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;
details.generated_sql: WITH revenue AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount, 0))) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY oi.product_id), rating AS (SELECT r.product_id, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews AS r GROUP BY r.product_id) SELECT p.product_id, p.name, rev.total_revenue, rat.avg_rating FROM products AS p JOIN revenue AS rev ON p.product_id = rev.product_id JOIN rating AS rat ON p.product_id = rat.product_id WHERE rat.avg_rating >= 4.0 ORDER BY rev.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: Compare year-over-year performance: total revenue, completed order count, and unique customers between 2023 and 2024.
details.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS yr, COUNT(order_id) AS orders_count, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) IN ('2023', '2024') GROUP BY strftime('%Y', order_date) ORDER BY yr ASC;
